Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd., based in Minhang, Shanghai, China, is a distinguished player in the chemical industry, recognized for its comprehensive portfolio of high-quality chemical products and solutions. Established in one of Asia’s most dynamic economic hubs, Meryer leverages Shanghai’s strategic location and advanced infrastructural resources to serve a broad spectrum of domestic and international clients. The company is deeply committed to research and development, consistently advancing its core competencies in chemical synthesis, purification, and specialty chemicals innovation.

Meryer offers an extensive range of products catering to various sectors, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, electronics, materials science, and environmental protection. Their product lines encompass analytical reagents, laboratory chemicals, custom synthesis solutions, and high-purity specialty chemicals, meeting both standard and highly specific customer requirements. Meryer’s laboratories and production facilities adhere to rigorous quality control standards, ensuring reliability, safety, and environmental responsibility across the entire supply chain.

In addition to its production activities, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. actively fosters collaborations with academic institutions, research organizations, and industry partners. This collaborative spirit fuels the company’s mission to deliver innovative products and tailored solutions that address emerging scientific and technological challenges. As a client-centric organization, Meryer emphasizes responsive customer support, technical expertise, and timely delivery, solidifying its reputation as a trusted partner in the chemical industry both in China and globally.
